run.rulesInOwnWords: Setup: six components, index 1 to 6, whole non-negative values. Each has a box bound c (10,8,12,6,9,7), an upper threshold u (7,6,9,5,7,5), a lower threshold d (3,2,4,2,3,2). Every flag starts INACTIVE. Budget B=38. Slack s starts at 0 and collects every amount that leaves the vector. Start x=(3,6,6,2,2,1). Five iterations, each runs Steps 1-5 in order, and each step is finished for all six components before the next step starts. Every division rounds down. STEP 1 (load): add row k of the input table to x, component by component. No bound is enforced here. STEP 2 (Gauss-Seidel sweep, the only place the box bound c is enforced): go 1,2,3,4,5,6 in order, using values already updated in this sweep. If x_i > c_i: v = x_i - c_i, set x_i = c_i, add v to x_(i+1). For component 6 add v to s instead. A violation passed down can push the next component over its own bound, which is then handled when the sweep reaches it. If x_i <= c_i, do nothing. STEP 3 (active-set update), using the post-Step-2 values: an INACTIVE flag becomes ACTIVE if x_i >= u_i. An ACTIVE flag becomes INACTIVE if x_i <= d_i. Otherwise the flag is unchanged, including when d_i < x_i < u_i. A flag changes at most once per iteration. Record each change as (iteration, component, before, after). STEP 4 (Jacobi transfer): first compute all six t_i from the values at the start of the step and the Step 3 flags. INACTIVE gives t_i = floor(x_i/4). ACTIVE gives t_i = floor(x_i/2). Then apply all six at once: every x_i falls by its own t_i. An INACTIVE component sends t_i to s. An ACTIVE component i (2 to 6) sends t_i to component i-1. ACTIVE component 1 sends t_1 to s. The box bound is not enforced here. Any excess is only fixed by Step 2 of the next iteration, and never if it arises in iteration 5. STEP 5 (penalty): sum x. If the sum is strictly more than 38, every x_i becomes floor(x_i/2), each removed amount goes to s, and the iteration is recorded as a reset. If the sum is 38 or less, nothing happens.
run.notes: Used a short Python script (solver.py) following the document literally: Gauss-Seidel sweep with cascading violations, Jacobi transfers from pre-transfer values, strict greater-than for the penalty. Re-derived iteration 1 and all Step 4 results by hand; matched. Penalty fired in iterations 1 (39) and 4 (47); iteration 5 sum exactly 38, no fire. End vector has x_2=10 (c_2=8) and x_4=7 (c_4=6) left uncorrected as the document specifies. Only the document was read.
